purpose: Rank remaining speed and binary-size blockers; diagnostic source copies and compiler settings only, no production source or installed compiler changes.

environment.load: Other user builds/browser processes active. Wall/cycle measurements are not qualified performance comparisons.

methodology.profiles: macOS sample at 1ms: 15s window of 1.5M-node current search, 12s each of original/current 5M evaluations, starting about 0.5s after launch. Main thread only. Self = inclusive minus immediate children; recursive inclusive functions deduplicated per sample. Sampling under shared-host load is diagnostic, not exact removable-overhead attribution.
methodology.semanticCounts: Node-only instrumented source copy counts helper invocations inside exactly the 250K-node search or one evaluation, after resetting counts following warmup. Fingerprint matches. These are source-level calls, not native call instructions; native inlining may remove call boundaries.
methodology.ablations: Two rotating native rounds per pair; whole-process retired instruction counts; Node original oracle checks mode/amount/checksum/detail and executable checks state restoration. Basic controls also cover perft4 and legal1000. Own-edge and typed-scratch controls assume the application's untouched array prototypes; they are not general compiler rewrites.
methodology.publicEdges: Three rotating rounds for plain/bounded at 1M/2M, each with 10K warmup; instruction slopes remove fixed process overhead. Warmup and result checksums match Node and native.
methodology.size: Thin ARM64 Mach-O __text extents from symbol-preserving binaries. Address deltas within section; aliases count once; padding belongs to preceding symbol. Stripped copies are ad-hoc signed. Retained bytes are not proof of safe removability.
methodology.build: Matching 2359699 compiler/runtime, app Os, specialized ABI, disabled caches, stock runtime O3/stdlib Os/ThinLTO/default features; repository unwind setup retained. All diagnostic headless copies use --function-source header. Capped comparisons change only PERRY_GUARDED_PREINLINE_MAX_IR_BYTES from default 65536 to 16384.
methodology.validationLimit: Diagnostic candidates have benchmark/state parity, not the full CLI/text/PTY acceptance suite. No preset/PR is promoted. Quiet-machine wall/RSS/startup checks remain necessary.

priorityFindings.name: Numeric array/iterator proof and excessive admitted checks
priorityFindings.evidence: 218,498,345 board reads; 146,074,039 bounds calls; 6,741,846 attacked calls in 250K-node search. Attacked 27.40% inclusive in sampled search. Indexed attack copy cuts about 12% of search instructions; bounds inline copy about 6%, not additive.

priorityFindings.name: Guarded pre-statepoint inlining growth budget
priorityFindings.evidence: Counted loops shrink attacked to a 3,488-byte standalone body but trigger alwaysinline and widespread caller growth: +381,888 __text bytes. Lower 16KiB ceiling on combined source removes 640,224 executable bytes and about 3.6% of search instructions. Compiler-only cap on untouched source saves 213,408 bytes with search instructions about +0.23%; no wall-time qualification.

priorityFindings.name: Negative/out-of-range numeric scratch-array access
priorityFindings.evidence: 25.37% inclusive of evaluation profile in js_array_get_index_or_string; explicit edge guards cut evaluation instructions about 22.3% and search about 3.9%. This path existed in original build too; it does not isolate the recent evaluation regression.

priorityFindings.name: Object/record handling and runtime dependency granularity
priorityFindings.evidence: 6,493,411 make/unmake pairs construct 14-field undo records per 250K-node search. Make 19.02% inclusive and unmake 6.68% (do not assume additive). Runtime object code 1,788,220 bytes and GC 764,144 bytes, plus C ABI entries counted separately. Retention chains show stdin->async iterator->Promise; IPC installer->JSON; typed-array hooks->species/filter->generic property lookup; many alternate paths prevent deleting one anchor from removing all code.

priorityFindings.name: Equivalent regular/$pshape bodies retained across modules
priorityFindings.evidence: Public two-module fixture retains duplicate 2,364-byte score and 2,792-byte text bodies. Full app has twelve equal-extent pairs totaling 110,736 bytes on one side, with semantic/site identity differences requiring proof before sharing.
